answer: Each epoch mints one single-use relic per bonded identity; without it, no attestation. A jittered whisper sets the offset; each identity must land on that epoch's jetty inside its slot, burning the relic on arrival. Cloning fails: each of 1,000 fake identities needs its own relic at 20,000 POA, locking 20,000,000 POA vs one honest bond of 20,000 POA. Enforcement: shared relic lineage or a correlated latency fingerprint slashes 100% of bond - 50% burned, 50% to the reporter - plus a 10-epoch ban. Honest limit: funded syndicates can still bulk-buy relics, so friction turns into wealth bias.
